verdict.rationale: Docs say anyone can use Apps Script to automate Admin console tasks in a low-code environment. Automatic user provisioning keeps account changes synced with third-party apps in the background. This is narrow, admin-focused automation, not general autonomous or AI-driven background workflows. Missing for 10: documented scheduled or event-driven triggers for automations running unattended, AI or agentic automations (e.g., Gemini-driven background tasks), end-user workflow automation beyond admin tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
